decisions.reason: Quotes the exact disabled expression, identifies busy as AttachButton-local state unbound in AttachmentChips, explains empty occurrences returning null before the map and plain-phase short-circuit fall-through causing ReferenceError.

Explains the render-phase throw is caught by the slot error boundary which unmounts the whole dock entry, the separate input.left attach-button slot survives, and the error is console-only with no visible banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 source to show busy pre-exists, proposes data-present plain-phase baseline mount plus rollback/re-add isolation, and discusses the extra imageItem scope defect in the diff without forcing the hover diff to be harmless; appropriately limits historical-exercise claims.

Removes the dangling reference or lifts properly owned busy state as a prop, preserving the phase guard; hardens record?.items ?? [] and event.target.closest?/Element guard; notes imageItem/status/record need proper scoping.

Proposes a render smoke with a SOURCE occurrence in plain phase asserting chip/remove DOM presence and no boundary capture, explains empty-state tests miss the line and that node --check only parses, and includes the data-present slot smoke in pre-ship checks.
